title: Business Architecture Principles ↔ Guardrails Matrix
description: Many-to-many mapping between Business Architecture Principles (BUS-PRN) and Business Architecture Guardrails (BUS-GRD) — showing which guardrails make which principles concrete and enforceable.

meta.description: Maps each Business Architecture Principle to the Guardrails that make it concrete and enforceable.
purpose: Shows which guardrails exist to enforce which principles, and surfaces principles with no enforcing guardrail
Supports impact analysis — if a principle changes, which guardrails need review?
Provides traceability from design guidance (the how) through to non-negotiable, enforceable rules (the where & with what)

$schema.description: URN of the schema this instance conforms to (this file's $id).

relationships.description: Sparse list of required mappings between BUS-PRN (columns) and BUS-GRD (rows). Presence of an entry means the guardrail is required to enforce the principle; absence means no required relationship.
